title: Device code + rotating keys storyboard for SDK quickstart (auth, streaming, tool calling)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact, developer-focused visual asset pack that explains: 1) device-code authentication for local/dev environments, 2) rotating API key lifecycle (generate > rotate > revoke) and 3) how streaming + tool-calling interact with auth headers and ephemeral keys. Deliverables: a 6-frame storyboard for the quickstart hero, three single-frame explainer diagrams (device code flow, key rotation timeline, streaming auth header lifecycle), componentized SVGs for inclusion in docs and SDK READMEs (light/dark), annotated code snippet overlays for Python + TypeScript, and export-ready PNG/JPEG/TIFF at docs and Retina sizes. Include accessibility alt-text and copy-ready microcopy for each frame.
dev_notes: Keep code snippets copy-paste ready; avoid placeholder tokens like <API_KEY> — use REDWOOD_API_KEY placeholder.
Confirm with ENG-5124 whether device-code polling interval should be visualized (they recommended 5s default).
Export SVGs with ID prefixes to avoid collisions when embedded in product docs.
Add a small footer explaining 'Dedicated vs Hosted' behavior for rotating keys—PM wants a callout.
